facts.fact: 晨起自嘲：我是幽灵——我已经不在了；昨晚偏头痛后她仍和衣而睡（缺靴袜）。
Ruth 的早餐：从空冰箱里变出鸡蛋与碎芝士+圆面包—— Ellison 的向日葵酸面包是 Ev「叫的人情」；不送饿着肚子的她回纽约。
facts.anchor: “I brought breakfast with us. Everett says you’re an eggs for breakfast girl?”

facts.fact: 打包清单：从镜柜收走三支新唇膏——Brooks 买的那批；「我最爱的一切都太大太人性或太马性，塞不进袋子」。
facts.anchor: I collect three fresh tubes of lip balm—the ones Brooks bought—from my bathroom cabinet

facts.fact: 地图点宣言：别人开车一掠而过的小镇——是她地图上的那个点：出生、长大、家的所在；And it’s where my heart is.（独段）。
facts.anchor: It might be a small dot on a map, a town people drive through without pausing to look at what’s outside the window, but it’s my map dot.

facts.fact: 离境画面：空客冲进德州日落时她无声地哭。
facts.anchor: I cry silently as the Airbus takes off into the Texas sunset.

facts.fact: 首偏头痛档案：13 岁那次让她卧床三天——另一种「父母的恐惧」：Austin 餐厅吃一口爸爸的虾仁宽面就无法呼吸（首过pedo过敏）；儿科医生说激素，三年后确诊 episodic migraine disorder（与月经周期相关）。
facts.anchor: At thirteen years old, I’d known a headache once or twice.

facts.fact: 药物雪上加霜：第一支药含贝壳类衍生物、医生没查出来——自然地立刻过敏；此后没有药真正挡得住。
facts.anchor: the first medicine I tried contained shellfish derivatives that my doctor didn’t notice

facts.fact: 慢性病金句：人人都谈慢性病的致残与禁忌——没人谈悲伤与内疚。
facts.anchor: But no one ever really talks about the grief or the guilt.

facts.fact: 三重哀悼：想念身体背叛前的女孩、希望成为的免于受苦的女孩——甚至两周前的女孩（秘密即将炸碎却站在世界之巅）。
facts.anchor: I miss the girl I used to be before my body rebelled, and I miss the girl I always hoped I’d be, the one who doesn’t have to suffer. I even miss the girl I was two weeks ago, when in spite of the secrets threatening to blow my life to

facts.fact: 宇宙的安排：送她回家正当时——需要看清对 Brooks 的感情深度；少女 crush 是某种更深的开始：一直爱着挚友、哥哥的挚友、她认识的最稳定的男人。
facts.anchor: The universe sent me home at the perfect time.

facts.fact: 玻璃判词：完美的两个月一路坠落建成美的东西——然后两人一起打碎它；「We’re not worth the risk. He told me as much.（他的原话）」。
facts.anchor: We had two perfect months of falling all the way in, of building something beautiful. And then between us, we broke it.

facts.fact: 1700 英里：他住在她脑子里还不交房租；心的裂谷也是 1700 英里宽。
facts.anchor: he’s living in my brain and paying no rent, and I can’t help but wonder where he is.
